- Model invocation via LLM has been disabled for this skill.
- No other changes to functionality or commands.

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches its stated purpose (scoring YouTube videos via a WorthClip API key) but has packaging inconsistencies and an unexpected API base URL that warrant caution and inspection before installing.

dimensions.detail: The skill's name, description, and runtime instructions consistently describe calling a WorthClip API to score videos; requiring an API key and use of curl/jq is reasonable. However, registry metadata earlier listed no required env vars while the SKILL.md metadata and instructions declare WORTHCLIP_API_KEY as the primary credential — this mismatch is an inconsistency in the packaging.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md directs the agent to run the included Bash scripts (score.sh, feed.sh, usage.sh) which is consistent with an instruction-only skill that performs HTTP requests. But the documented Base URL is https://greedy-mallard-11.convex.site/api/v1 — an opaque subdomain not obviously belonging to worthclip.com. That raises a concern because the description tells the user to obtain a key from worthclip.com/developers; the runtime endpoint should be verified to belong to the same service. Also verify the scripts themselves for any references to other env vars or unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only with included scripts). This is lower-risk than arbitrary downloads or package installs. The provided scripts will run locally when invoked; nothing is being written or installed by an installer spec.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: At runtime the skill declares a single primary credential (WORTHCLIP_API_KEY), which is proportionate for an API client. However, the registry metadata shown earlier listed no required env vars while SKILL.md metadata requires WORTHCLIP_API_KEY — this discrepancy could be an authoring/packaging error and should be resolved. Before use, confirm the skill only requires that single API key and that scripts do not read other secrets or unexpected config paths.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always: true and sets disable-model-invocation: true in the SKILL.md, so the model cannot autonomously invoke it and it's not permanently injected into every agent run. This significantly reduces the risk of silent credential use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
This skill looks like a normal API client for WorthClip but there are two things to check before installing:

1) Verify the API base URL (https://greedy-mallard-11.convex.site/api/v1) actually belongs to WorthClip (e.g., ask the publisher or check documentation at worthclip.com). An unexpected domain could be a proxy or a malicious endpoint.
2) Inspect the included scripts (scripts/score.sh, scripts/feed.sh, scripts/usage.sh) to confirm they only use WORTHCLIP_API_KEY, curl, and jq and do not read other environment variables, local files, or post data to other endpoints. Also confirm the scripts do not write sensitive data to disk.

Additional recommended steps: confirm the publisher identity or homepage, ensure the package metadata is corrected to declare WORTHCLIP_API_KEY as required, and only supply an API key scoped/limited for this use (or a test key) until you are confident in the skill's behavior.
